title: Keystroke
subtitle: Multiplayer typing races, live
description: Share a room code and race friends in real-time, no sign-up. A Redis leaderboard pushes rank changes as people type. The whole stack runs in Docker.

title: PrepMate
subtitle: AI interview prep
description: Practice a job interview out loud. It listens, adapts its questions to your resume or the job description, then scores your answers on relevance and clarity when you're done.

title: AuthSystem
subtitle: Login done properly
description: A complete authentication service: email verification, password resets, refresh-token rotation and Google/GitHub OAuth. Emails and OTPs run through a background queue instead of blocking the request.
